clips.send: A country has hundreds of laws. If two of them disagree, which one wins? In China the answer is the Constitution (宪法, xiànfǎ). Chinese students learn that it is “the fundamental law of the state” — the rulebook that every other rule has to follow. Build the pyramid of laws yourself and find out why it sits at the top.
